description: This file defines a Fastify plugin for capturing HTTP requests and responses for shadow testing purposes. It includes hooks for request lifecycle events, functions for capturing and logging request/response data, and utility functions for object property filtering.

methods.name: captureRequest
methods.description: Captures and buffers request data, writing to log files when buffer exceeds size.

methods.name: captureReply
methods.description: Captures and buffers response data, writing to log files when buffer exceeds size.

methods.name: omit
methods.description: Returns a subset of an object or array with specified properties or items removed.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Returns a subset of an object or array with only specified properties or items.
